title: model-diff: PR-tracked files under target/ cannot replace the base-built validator, and the trusted base must be development or main

criteria.given: the step that runs the validator (java -cp)
criteria.then: the classpath contains only the base-built tool copied outside the checkout (under RUNNER_TEMP), never saiku-core/saiku-service/target or target/classpath.txt in the checkout
it has a branches filter limited to development and main, and the base SHA is verified to be an ancestor of origin/development or origin/main before credentials are written

criteria.given: the base SHA and the setup steps
criteria.then: BASE_SHA is bound to pull_request.base.sha (never the head SHA) and no Maven cache is restored (no cache: maven)
no mvn command runs after the PR head is checked out again, and settings.xml is removed before that checkout

criteria.given: a pull request that changes the diff tool or the workflow itself
criteria.then: the report says the change was not exercised instead of reporting that no semantic model changed
no file is tracked under a target/ directory
